entities.summary: Louis-James Alfred Lefébure-Wély was a French organist and composer. He played a major role in the development of the French symphonic organ style and was closely associated with the organ builder Aristide Cavaillé-Coll, inaugurating many new Cavaillé-Coll organs. Alfred Lefébure-Wély was a composers & musicians from Paris (1817-11-13, Paris–1869-12-31). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
